sources.title: GitHub - Suhen02/bert-finetuned-imdb
sources.snippet: This repository contains a Jupyter/Colab notebook that demonstrates how to fine‑tune BERT for sentiment analysis on the IMDb movie reviews dataset. The notebook walks through: Loading and preprocessing the IMDb dataset Tokenizing text with Hugging Face transformers Fine‑tuning BERT for binary classification (positive vs negative reviews) Evaluating the model's performance

sources.title: GitHub - AryaPathak/BERT-FineTuned-for-IMDB
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates how to fine-tune a pre-trained BERT model (bert-base-uncased) on the IMDB movie review dataset using TensorFlow and Hugging Face Transformers. The goal is to classify reviews as positive or negative.

sources.title: Fine-Tuning BERT for Robust Sentiment Classification of IMDb Reviews
sources.snippet: The study involves text preprocessing to remove noise, tokeniz-ing reviews using BERT's WordPiece tokenizer, and optimizing deep contextual embeddings for binary sentiment classification. The performance of the BERT-based model is compared against traditional machine learning baselines to eval-uate improvements in accuracy and robustness.
